question: Where do full-recording spatial-pattern or projected field changes warrant temporal-observability review?
scope: Eight published BOI sources, all 7200 frames at exact external 1 Hz. Diagnostic transforms only; no source resampling, detector, mask adoption, exclusion, correction or window approval.

method.registration: MATLAB R2025a imregcorr(moving,fixed,translation,Method=gradcorr), explicit method. Native single source pixels, whole image, no mask, smoothing or intensity threshold. First frame is fixed reference for every frame; preceding frame is second reference except frame 1.
method.coordinates: Translation returned is the estimated correction taking moving coordinates into fixed coordinates. Export column/x and row/y corrections in pixels and micrometres. It is not independently established physical tissue motion.
method.quality: Retain peak correlation for both references and direct unregistered Pearson correlation to frame 1. No score or displacement acceptance threshold. Failed estimates remain NaN with error text.
method.profiles: Exact whole-frame row sums and column sums of stored intensities for every frame; cast original exact-integer source pixels to double before summation and store projections as uint32.
method.review_selection: For each source select earliest largest correction magnitude to first reference, earliest largest adjacent correction magnitude (frames 2..N), earliest smallest fixed-reference peak score (frames 2..N). Show first reference and before/at each selection; choices are diagnostic clues, not exclusions.
method.figures: Full time traces plus row/column mean kymographs, fixed shared source display ranges from 021. No tissue denominator or frame-valid declaration inferred.
method.synthetic_check: Three translated copies of deterministic random-pattern reference, including gain/offset and unchanged cases. Known correction direction verified within 0.15 pixel; numerical harness check only, not scientific motion tolerance.
method.limits: Rigid translation cannot certify local deformation, focus, occlusion or signal validity. Biological intensity-pattern changes may alter estimates. Frame-1 reference may itself be imperfect; no reference selection tuning.

source_evidence_search: Case-insensitive filename search for shift/motion/regist/align/reference/mean/std/moco/template within each source recording subtree found no matches. Limited filename evidence, not proof that historical transforms or references do not exist elsewhere.
success: Synthetic direction check passes; every original frame has a diagnostic row with original index; projection conservation matches prior independently verified pixel sums; source/implementation hashes unchanged; selected frames inspected.
stop: One fixed diagnostic pass. No iterative registration tuning, anatomical acceptance, exclusion or motion correction follows automatically.

completion.remaining: Focused local-sequence/landmark review, uncertain boundary evidence and measurement-specific validity decisions; no automatic exclusions.
